summary: [Google Forms API] objects: Form (formId, info{title, documentTitle, description}, items[], settings, linkedSheetId, revisionId), FormResponse (responseId, answers keyed by questionId, lastSubmittedTime), Watch (id, eventType, target Pub/Sub topic, expireTime, state). Methods: forms.create (title only; add items via batchUpdate), forms.get/update/batchUpdate, forms.responses.list/get, forms.watches.create/list/delete/renew.
